keywords: Inspection process 2.Effective 3.Data handling skill 4.Reliability 5.Science and technology PBL
educationalGoal: Students will:(1) learn a skill of inspection process of a hypothesis or the solution to the problem concept,(2) understand a phenomenon, an object, a phenomenon quantitatively and qualitatively,(3) tell information to a third party clearly,(4) learn various skills required for pushing forward inspection activity smoothly,(5) imagine a technical area and an engineer image to learn in architecture.
advice: Students learn how to lead processes to inspect a hypothesis or learn how to lead processes to inspect effectiveness / acceptance characteristics of the specific part among the characteristics of a concept aiming at a solution to the problem or the concept.In part students learn "a building design skill" to need data in collection → rearranging → analysis → hypothesis → visualization → report. In part "a structure design skill" to lead to the inspection, "an environmental design skill" and "an element skill of the inspection activity" are learned by the drafting of the hypothesis.(1) Building design skill:Students announce the design of a house that an individual designed in a group and narrow it down to one basic design plan based on exchange of opinions. Students make the 1/20 model of the house.(2) Structure design skill:Based on basic design plan, students examine construction and how to structure and the method of construction. Students examine examination and the transformation of the material of the Class basic axis and perform the loading experiment with the model.(3) Environmental design skill:Based on basic design plan, students perform the examination of the environmental characteristic (insulation characteristics, sound, illumination, air conditioning, ventilation) while using analysis tools.(4) Inspection activity skill: Students summarize result provided by a series of design activity in a project report and announce the team by a poster session and plan communalization of the knowledge in the whole class.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to have the experience that worked on design of a house in individuals as a design problem. It is desirable to learn the basics of how to write building plan. It is desirable to review the common rule including how to write dimensions, a building term and the drawing symbol that the design is a team and will wrestle.

achievementLevels.ideal: Using the technique that student devised by a team, students inspect solution suggestion and can evaluate it from plural viewpoints logically. Based on an evaluation result of the solution suggestion, student can review a design of the suggestion. Furthermore, student can think about social use of the solution suggestion. Student can summarize activity result in a project report in a logical sentence clearly. Student can explain activity result by a poster and a presentation clearly. Furthermore, student can cope with questions and answers appropriately.
achievementLevels.standard: Using the technique that student devised by a team, student can evaluate solution suggestion. Based on an evaluation result of the solution suggestion, student can review a design of the suggestion. Student can summarize activity result in a project report. Student can explain activity result by a poster and a presentation clearly. *Tardy and absence, the negative activity (team activity nonparticipation) deduct points of a personal acquisition point as a penalty of the action posture.
